answer_1.quote: The single-modal generation tasks include: generative conversational question answering on the CoQA dataset, question generation on the SQuAD 1.1 dataset, abstractive summarization on the CNN/DailyMail (CNNDM) dataset, and sentence compression on the Gigaword dataset.
answer_1.outputs: generated questions, summaries, and compressed sentences

answer_2.quote: R-1, R-2 and R-L denote ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-L, respectively. Mat, Per, B4 and ME denote Matthews correlation coefficient, Pearson correlation coefficient, BLUE4 and METEOR, respectively.
